name: Qualtrics
oneLiner: Enterprise experience management (XM) platform for customer, employee and brand research, with location CX dashboards, an online reputation management module and AI Experience Agents.
bestFor: Large, multi-unit restaurant and hospitality brands with dedicated CX or insights teams that want surveys, reviews and operational feedback in one enterprise program.

updates.text: At X4 2026 (Seattle, March 17-19), new CEO Jason Maynard's first X4, Qualtrics said its AI Experience Agents are live with paying customers and announced real-time service recovery agents and omnichannel connectors for Genesys, NICE and Salesforce.
Qualtrics completed its $6.75 billion acquisition of Press Ganey Forsta (announced October 2025), adding healthcare patient-experience data and the InMoment business Press Ganey had bought in 2025.

features: Omnichannel feedback collection: post-transaction surveys by email, SMS, web, app, QR and chat
Online reputation management that pulls public reviews from sites such as Google alongside survey data
Location CX dashboards with role-based views for restaurant managers, market managers and executives
AI text and sentiment analytics that group open-ended comments and reviews into themes
Experience Agents: AI agents that act on feedback, for example real-time service recovery
Predictive analytics on drivers of satisfaction and churn risk
Brand research (BrandXM) and employee experience programs on the same platform
Connectors to contact-center and CRM systems such as Genesys, NICE and Salesforce

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Qualtrics does not publish prices for its CX suite. Contact sales for a quote.

notes: Dropped from the current review: 'starts at approximately $50,000-$100,000+ per year' and 'pricing based on customer interactions' (not published by Qualtrics). 'Government institutions' and ServiceNow as customers not re-verified; Shake Shack confirmed. KFC figures (300% more feedback, ~30-32K restaurants) are vendor-published. The Press Ganey deal is mainly healthcare; it does not change the restaurant offering. Qualtrics is privately held (taken private by Silver Lake in 2023). X4 2026 details come from press coverage, not a Qualtrics release.
